name: pure-work-mobile
description: Pure Work iOS/Android app shell for the Pure Work web platform

scripts.native:add:android: npx cap add android && node scripts/apply-branding.mjs android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android
scripts.native:add:ios: npx cap add ios && node scripts/apply-branding.mjs ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
scripts.sync:android: npx cap sync android && node scripts/apply-branding.mjs android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android
scripts.sync:ios: npx cap sync ios && node scripts/apply-branding.mjs ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
